Name: Ashley Allen
Badge: Everyday Sparks 2.0
Which strategy from this module (Daily Schedule, Take a Line for a Walk or Interpreting Visual Texts) feels most immediately usable in your teaching context? Why?:

Take a Line for a Walk feels immediately usable in my classroom. I think that this could be beneficial to use while teaching novel studies in the ELA classroom. Our school is working towards giving students more rigorous questioning and this would be great for that!

What other strategies or approaches have you used to engage your students in routine writing over the course of this school year? What, if any, challenges have you encountered in engaging students in sustained routine writing?:
I have implemented writing notebooks in the classroom and feel that it has been very beneficial. Students are writing more often which is helping them become more comfortable and build their writing skills.
